description: Task priority: store, show, edit and filter a priority on each task.

userStories.title: Store a priority on each task
userStories.description: As a developer, I need each task to keep a priority so that it survives restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration adds a priority column with the values high, medium and low, default medium
The migration runs forward and back on an empty test database

userStories.title: Return the priority from the tasks API
userStories.description: As a client, I want the priority in every task response so that I can display it.
acceptanceCriteria: Contract test covers the new field

userStories.title: Show a priority badge on each task card
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see each task's priority at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: Each task card shows a badge with the priority as text, not colour alone
End-to-end test checks the badge in a browser

userStories.title: Filter the task list by priority
userStories.description: As a user, I want to list only high-priority tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter control offers All, High, Medium and Low and keeps the choice in the URL
An empty result shows a message instead of a blank list
End-to-end test checks the filter in a browser
